missions.task: Prepare concise English editorial passages for Motux (duplicate existing map stages 4 and 5) and Vilcas (stage 15), using selected evidence IDs. Maximum 170 words total, with at most three supported claims and no minimum word count. No freehand quotations or generated URLs. These are private proposals; a human decides publication. If evidence cannot support a requested detail, report the limitation.
